blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon has reminded Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte that engaging in brawls is an issue thrown at him and not against the prosecution team. The reminder comes as the Davao lawmaker claimed that the withdrawal of impeachment articles looks like throwing punches and suddenly backing out. In a press briefing on Wednesday, Ridon and other members of the public prosecution team were asked about Duterte’s statements. The House member’s pronouncements were in response to the panel’s decision to withdraw three out of four articles of impeachment against his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. […]...
